lede: The biggest civic moment this week is the Gondola Leadership Committee meeting on July 28, where the committee takes up background and history as an action item alongside a briefing on CIG funding commitments and a project update — the most consequential ongoing question in this valley right now. Elsewhere, Town Council sits Monday as the Liquor Licensing Authority for a public hearing on KOTO's Live at the Drive permit, and the week fills out with electronics recycling, a climate forum, Market on the Plaza, and live music to close it out Thursday.
